newsitem.title: DUBAI: ETA wins $64 mln UAE desalination plant project.
newsitem.headline: ETA wins $64 mln UAE desalination plant project.

text.p: Emirates Trading Agency (ETA) said on Thursday it had won a 235 million dirham ($64 million) deal for the construction of five water desalination plants in the northern United Arab Emirates.

General manager of ETA's power projects division T.C. Ravindran said the deal for five units, each with capacity of 1.5 million gallons per day, was signed with the ministry of electricity and water on Wednesday.
Japan's Sasakura Engineering is supplying the processing plants for the project, he said.
Two plants each will be built in Fujairah and Ajman and one plant will be set up in Ras al-Khaimah.
Ravindran said the project would take around two years to complete.
